title: Refining
summary: Ma Liang's comrades return to the War Shrine Sect in the Fire Country, and Wang Lin, still posing as Ma Liang, hands Elder Huo his collected materials and goes off alone. In a quiet retreat he explores Ma Liang's body and sea of consciousness, where his Extreme consciousness wakes the Heaven Defying Bead and his little sword. A year later he reaches mid Foundation Establishment. At the Burning Gold Mountains, where the four great sects pick the Burning Gold Fruit, he takes the plant whole, and the Tiangang Sect cultivator Xu Liguo takes him for a devil. Wang Lin erases the original consciousness of Xu Liguo, a former Nascent Soul cultivator, and trains his soul into his own devil servant. He holds the soul blood of Lin Tao and the other two to make them fetch weapon-refining jade slips and maps, then a Nascent Soul elder appears and demands his disciple's soul blood back.
